title: Understanding the Problem
text: The problem involves distributing $$8$$ blocks across $$4$$ machines, with each block being replicated twice. Each block is stored on $$2$$ different machines.

title: Calculate Total Replicas
text: Since each of the $$8$$ blocks is replicated $$2$$ times, calculate the total number of replicas that need to be stored across the machines.

title: Total Replicas Calculation
text: Calculate the total number of replicas by multiplying the number of blocks by the number of replicas per block.

title: Distribute Replicas Evenly
text: The total number of replicas (16) needs to be distributed evenly across $$4$$ machines. How many replicas will each machine store?

title: Calculate Replicas per Machine
text: Divide the total number of replicas by the number of machines to find out how many replicas each machine will store.
